name: authority:self
description: baobab-cp's authority:self scope (ADR-BCP-020 sections 99-102, 110): a human administrator reads their own effective administrative authority, GET /v1/admin/effective-authority. Read-only, non-privileged, human-only; it reveals only the caller's own grants and confers no authority. Baobab owns its semantics (Shared scope-registry.yaml); this provider only issues it. Carries aud=baobab-control-plane.
